summary: Namib Minerals filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of director Ibrahima Tall effective June 3, 2026, with no disagreement involved, and the appointment of Pascoal Alberto Bacela as a Class II independent director and audit committee member effective June 4, 2026, filling the vacancy from Molly P. Zhang's prior resignation. Mr. Bacela brings energy sector expertise from Mozambique. No deal terms, prices, or strategic transactions were disclosed. This is a routine board change with no special-situation catalyst; watch for any future strategic shifts under the new director's influence.
